coal.title: Coal Mining (Singareni)
coal.prompt: Semi-realistic 3D illustration, landscape 4:3, 3840 px wide. A large open-cast coal mine in Telangana with terraced black coal benches, a big yellow-orange dumper truck and an excavator loading coal, a conveyor belt and a coal handling tower in the background. Warm golden-hour light, deep plum (#4A0E3F) evening sky, apricot (#F5A23A) highlights on machines, cream and charcoal tones. Keep the top 15% as plain plum sky. No people's faces, no text, no logos, no watermark.

mineworkers.title: Mine Workers
mineworkers.prompt: Semi-realistic 3D illustration, landscape 4:3, 3840 px wide. Coal mine entrance with steel headframe and mine rail trolleys full of coal; three miners seen from behind in helmets with cap lamps, orange safety vests and boots, walking toward the shaft. Warm golden-hour light, deep plum (#4A0E3F) sky, apricot (#F5A23A) lamp glow, dignified mood. Top 15% plain plum sky. No faces shown, no text, no logos, no watermark.

industry.title: Industry & Factories
industry.prompt: Semi-realistic 3D illustration, landscape 4:3, 3840 px wide. Warm golden-hour light, deep plum (#4A0E3F) sky, apricot (#F5A23A) accents, cream buildings. Top 15% plain plum sky. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

strike.title: Labour Strike / Workers' Protest
strike.prompt: Semi-realistic 3D illustration, landscape 4:3, 3840 px wide. Peaceful group of workers in helmets and work clothes gathered outside a factory or mine gate holding blank placards and plain red flags, seen from behind or at a distance. Warm golden-hour light, deep plum (#4A0E3F) sky, apricot (#F5A23A) accents. Calm, non-violent. Top 15% plain plum sky. No readable text on placards, no faces in close-up, no logos, no watermark.
